completed_checks.finding: No literal TODO, TBD, or FIXME marker occurs in maintained DITA maps or topics.
The inventory excludes generated HTML, PDF, delivery, report, cache, and installed-site output; source, transform, and contract owners remain the only editable evidence.

findings.title: Explain system-language selection and fallback exactly

rules: The System mode considers navigator.languages in order and then navigator.language.
Browser tags match en, ru, de, zh-CN/zh-Hans/zh, fr, and es-ES/es rules after underscore-to-hyphen normalization.
The first available matching catalog wins; an unavailable match follows its declared fallback, then en, then the first available catalog.
An explicit language selection is persisted as bpm-lang-mode; System is persisted as a mode, not as a frozen resolved locale.

findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: Current topics may state the supported six-locale set and that System follows browser preferences, but must not claim an unspecified fallback order or partial-catalog behavior.

findings.title: Make import and export examples unambiguously full Firefox policies.json documents
findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: The text must continue to distinguish BPM normalized flags from the Firefox boundary document. It must not present an inner flags/settings fragment as a deployable policies.json file.

findings.title: Replace stale release-qualified reader claims while preserving the delivered assistant boundary

authoritative_behavior.release_boundary: The delivered assistant shows its localized training notice; it does not generate answers, retrieve an index, use citations, or use external sources. Deterministic documentation search remains independent.

findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: Preserve the truthful unavailable-feature boundary and never document model installation, generated answers, citations, retrieval, or external sources as delivered.

findings.title: Normalize semantic UI names and visible admonition labels
findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: Do not replace codeph/API/path semantics with UI markup, and do not change UI copy merely to obtain formatting.

findings.title: Give every maintained figure a localized caption, consecutive numbering, and cross-reference contract
findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: Keep screenshots as reviewed source assets, do not hand-edit rendered PDF images, and do not infer instructional meaning from an unlabeled image alone.

findings.title: Make title pages, printed page numbers, and contents navigation verifiable
findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: Chromium remains the renderer. Do not add a second PDF renderer or patch generated PDFs by hand; the title-page copyright must remain sourced from the exact UI-footer locale text.

findings.title: Record the six-locale editorial and binary-PDF release review
findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: No generated PDF, delivery directory, or installed-site artifact is evidence of acceptance until source-driven verification and visual six-locale review complete.

findings.title: Refresh technical architecture and operational runbooks after the 0.9.4 implementation changes
findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: This inventory does not rewrite technical procedures or reclassify product behavior; M11-07 owns executable command and owner updates.

findings.title: Optimize PDF work only after the reviewed print layout is stable
findings.safe_boundary_until_remediated: Do not add caching, partial builds, or parallel rendering before M11-06 records stable layout and reproducibility evidence.
